loop.top3_why: The median strategy (C) achieves the best overall validation score (0.6826) and shows stable per‑window performance (0.665, 0.688, 0.686). loop.top3_why_not: A provides perfect consistency but its score is 0.008 higher than C, and it lacks robustness to outliers which may hurt on the blind window. B has the worst per‑window performance and a higher overall score, making it less reliable given the high variance in weight estimation and correlated errors.
